# ledger_grants (Data Source)

The grant vocabulary of Ledger: the resources and actions a token can be granted, and the grants each role has. Useful when declaring token grants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The grant vocabulary, e.g. to see which grants only administrators can hold.
data "ledger_grants" "all" {}

output "admin_only_resources" {
  value = [for r in data.ledger_grants.all.resources : r.name if r.admin_only]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `resources` (Attributes List) The resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `roles` (Attributes List) The roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (List of String) read and or write.
- `admin_only` (Boolean) True when only administrators can hold it.
- `description` (String) What it covers.
- `name` (String) The resource name, as in name:read.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `grants` (List of String) The grants of the role.
- `name` (String) administrator or read-only.
